note: Wooded campground high on the Foothills Parkway West in Great Smoky Mountains National Park. The park tells anyone towing to avoid GPS routes over Montvale, Happy Valley and Flats roads. --Claude
summary: Look Rock (GSMNP) checked on rec.gov facility, rates, catalog and calendars: OPERATING (2026 nights sold through 10-25, nearly full late October; 2027 bookable from 05-28); 68 sites, 10 electric (all 50 A + water, no sewer); rigs to 48 ft; flush toilets, water, dump, no showers; $30 / $36 electric; reservation required; season 05-08..10-26 in 2026. Not waterfront.
